name: Round Circuit
description: Swing the arm in a full round so qi completes a loop through the body and lands in the fist.

name: Heel Circuit
description: Send the loop down to the heel and push off it so the next stride comes quick and light.

name: Spine Rise
description: Lift a bright line of qi up the spine so the user stands taller and moves with a freer back.

name: Arm Loop
description: Spin qi around the forearm like a wheel so a striking hand is thrown off its line.

name: Circuit Mark
description: Touch a foe and feel which of their limbs carries the strongest qi so the next blow can go there.

name: Wheel Palm
description: Turn the whole wheel of qi into one palm strike that lands hard and knocks the foe's own flow out of step.

name: Full Circuit
description: Keep the complete wheel turning round the body so blows are turned and the user's limbs gain a little extra drive.

name: Compact Palm
description: Pack qi tight into the palm before the strike so it lands with the weight of a stone.

name: Close Coil
description: Wind qi into a close coil around the chest so a hard blow compresses it and fails to pass.

name: Coil Spring
description: Load the legs with a wound coil of qi and let it spring free for one long bound.

name: Coil Read
description: Feel how tightly a foe has packed their own qi and judge how hard their next blow will be.

name: Seedburst
description: Pack a seed of qi into the palm and crack it open on contact so force bursts in every direction.

name: Coil Lance
description: Squeeze the coil through two fingers into a narrow spear of force that drives through a guard.

name: Left Channel
description: Pour qi down the left arm only and strike with it while the right arm stays ready.

name: Right Channel
description: Hold qi in the right arm alone and sweep aside an incoming strike with a light brush.

name: Channel Hop
description: Switch the weight of qi from one leg to the other as you spring to the side.

name: Channel Soothe
description: Run one arm's qi into a hurt place on an ally or yourself while the other arm keeps guard.

name: Channel Probe
description: Send qi down one arm into a touched surface to feel what lies in or behind it.

name: Cross Channel
description: Cross both arms' qi at the fingertips of one hand and thrust it through a thin gap in a guard.

name: Split Current
description: Strike with one arm and turn aside the answering blow with the other in the same breath.

name: Dual Swell
description: Drive both arms' qi forward at once so two broad surges meet in front and shove back those near.

name: Echo Palm
description: Strike a half beat after the foe's blow so your qi rides in on the recoil.

name: Echo Brace
description: Take a blow on a hard patch of qi and let the force ring out through the arm.

name: Beat Slide
description: Slip a step to the side on the quiet beat between two enemy strikes.

name: Beat Tally
description: Count the rhythm of a foe's heart and breath to know when the next strike will fall.

name: Return Wave
description: Catch a thrown wave of qi on the palm and push it back toward the sender with a flick.

name: Rebound Pulse
description: Take a strike on a braced guard and send the same force back through it as a pulse.

name: Answering Throb
description: Answer a clumsy blow with a precise beat of qi that jars the attacker's balance and breath.

name: Thin Layer
description: Lay one fine film of qi on the skin that dulls a glancing hit.

name: Thick Layer
description: Pile qi on one limb until it holds a heavy blow without bruising the arm beneath.

name: Layer Strike
description: Peel a layer of qi off the guard and throw it into the target with a snap of the palm.

name: Layer Peel
description: Pull at the edge of a foe's own veil with a hooked thread until a patch tears loose.

name: Triple Layer
description: Stack three veils of qi so each takes part of a great blow and the last stays whole.

name: Layered Palm
description: Strike with palm and three layers of qi in turn so the foe is struck and pinned in one motion.

name: Salve Breath
description: Breathe out a stream of qi onto a shallow wound of yourself or an ally to close and cool it.

name: Gentle Current
description: Pass a mild steady current through a sprain on yourself or an ally until the joint loosens.

name: Limb Ease
description: Draw cramped qi from a numb arm or leg of yourself or an ally and spread it evenly.

name: Ache Drain
description: Pull the throb of a fresh bruise out of an ally or yourself with a quick sweep of the hand.

name: Wrist Reading
description: Hold a wrist and follow the pulse to learn how deep an injury runs in an ally.

name: Strength Return
description: Lend a slow warm stream of qi to a weary ally or yourself until the limbs feel strong again.

name: Clearing Flow
description: Wash a clotted channel of an ally or yourself with a clear flow that carries off stale or tainted qi.

name: Closing Thread
description: Draw a deep cut shut with threads of qi on yourself or an ally and bind the flesh until it holds.

name: Backlash Ease
description: Soothe the raw backlash of a failed circulation in an ally or yourself and steady the stirred qi.

name: Reach Thread
description: Fling a long thread of qi from the fingertip and let it lash a target a few paces off.

name: Thread Haul
description: Hook a thread to a foe's wrist or weapon and yank to spoil their stroke.

name: Outreach Feeling
description: Let a long thread drift outward and read the people or things it brushes along its length.

name: Thread Brace
description: Weave threads across the chest like a loose net that catches and slows a thrown missile.

name: Thread Tether
description: Tether a thread to a nearby post or branch and pull the body across a short gap.

name: Long Thread
description: Drive a long hardened thread through a gap in a guard and pin the struck limb in place.

name: Thread Net
description: Cast a net of fine threads over a small area to hold what it catches and report every tug.

name: Cycle Blow
description: Breathe out as the arm drives forward so the full outbreath carries qi into the blow.

name: Cycle Brace
description: Breathe in as a blow arrives and draw qi to the point of impact to harden it.

name: Long Exhale
description: Let out one very long breath to settle the qi and give the next movement a clean start.

name: Inhale Dash
description: Take a sharp breath in and dash on the draw of the lungs for a short fast burst.

name: Renewal Cycle
description: Turn the breath into a slow wheel that mends small hurts in an ally or yourself and refills the qi spent.

name: Breath Surge
description: Hold a full breath then expel it with all the stored qi as a broad shove of force.
